name: FR I Nyaa
description: Anime torrents from Nyaa, filtered to French releases (VOSTFR / VF / MULTI). Nyaa is a public tracker, so this needs NO passkey and hands Seanime real magnet links. Searches the 'Non-English-translated' category by default; toggle the French filter, category, sort, and mirror in the settings.
